description: This file contains the implementation of the TokenizerHelper class, which provides tokenization functionality for parsing strings, including handling quoted tokens, separators, and whitespace. It is part of the internal PDFsharp library for PDF processing.

classes.name: TokenizerHelper
classes.description: A helper class for tokenizing strings with support for quotes, separators, and whitespace handling.

methods.name: TokenizerHelper
methods.description: Constructs a TokenizerHelper with a string and format provider or custom quote and separator characters.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes internal fields and skips initial whitespace.

methods.name: NextTokenRequired
methods.description: Returns the next token, throwing if no token is available.

methods.name: LastTokenRequired
methods.description: Ensures that no extra data remains after tokenization.

methods.name: NextToken
methods.description: Advances to the next token, with optional quoted token allowance.

methods.name: ScanToNextToken
methods.description: Skips whitespace and separator characters to position at the start of the next token.

methods.name: GetNumericListSeparator
methods.description: Determines the list separator character based on locale, typically ',' or ';'.
